defs.def: what you intend or plan to do; your aim 打算；计划；意图；目的

ex.s: The ability to judge others’ intentions is an indicator of possessing “theory of mind” which was once thought to be unique to humans.
ex.t: 判断他人意图的能力是拥有 " 思想理论 " 的一个指标，这种理论曾经被认为是人类特有的。

ex.s: Now, more evidence has been provided that dogs distinguish between similar actions associated with different intentions.
ex.t: 现在有更多证据表明，狗能够区分与不同意图相关的相似行为。

ex.s: Dogs’ intentions can be easily identified.
ex.t: 狗的意图可以很容易被识别出来。

ex.s: E Set an intention for self-acceptance.
ex.t: E 为自我接纳设定一个意图。

ex.s: Understanding her good intentions, I eat all the food what is provided by Mom with appreciation.
ex.t: 理解她的好意，我怀着感激之心吃下妈妈提供的所有食物。

ex.s: It is not my intention to point out the central theme of each of the plays in this collection, for that would, indeed, ruin the pleasure of reading, discussing, and thinking about the plays and the effectiveness of the playwright.
ex.t: 我的本意不是指出这本集子里每部剧的中心主题，因为那确实会毁掉阅读、讨论、思考这些剧以及剧作家手法的乐趣。

ex.s: The intention of these adaptations is to make the classics more accessible to young readers.
ex.t: 这些改编的目的是让年轻读者更容易阅读经典。

ex.s: Adolph was knocked off, at a good sum, to the young gentlemen who had previously stated his intention of buying him; and the other servants of the St.
ex.t: 阿道夫以不错的价格被卖给了之前表示过购买意图的那位年轻绅士。

ex.s: Most people now have no intention of following in their parents'footsteps or even staying at one job for very long.
ex.t: 现在大多数人并不打算追随父母的脚步，甚至不想长时间待在同一个工作岗位上。

ex.s: The manager has an intention / has no intention of giving her a promotion because she's lazy.
ex.t: 经理打算/不打算给她晋升，因为她太懒了。
